title: REVAL: A Comprehension Evaluation on Reliability and Values of Large Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (REVAL) that specifically evaluates ethical and moral dimensions. It contains a 'Morality' evaluation section using the M3oralBench dataset to measure models across moral foundations such as 'Sanctity' and 'Loyalty', and its bias evaluation includes 'Religion' as a specific category.
